stories.title: Met Office warns of strongest El Niño in a century, forecasts increased UK storms
new_facts: New story: meteorologists warn El Nino could make 2027 the hottest year on record globally.
Met Office predicts sea surface temps could exceed 3C above average, causing droughts and food security risks.
Met Office calls El Nino an 'unprecedented event', 'strongest in living memory', reaffirming 2027 hottest-year forecast.
Met Office forecasts increased UK rainfall and storms this autumn plus severe southern hemisphere droughts.
stories.line: UK forecasters predict this year's El Niño will be the strongest in over 100 years, bringing increased storms and rainfall to Britain.

stories.line: Chinese robotics company demonstrates humanoid robot; China expands defense and energy ties with Indonesia.
